headline: Water endgame team
title: Best Water Team | Sherro Panpanta Piopiota Glacy | Aniimo Guide
video_script: For endgame, try the Water team of Sherro, Panpanta, Piopiota and Prismana Glacy. Panpanta and Piopiota lay water puddles that boost Sherro's Water damage. Open with Panpanta to break the shield, then switch to Prismana Glacy for her damage buff, and let Sherro deliver the big bursts. Keep Sherro near the puddles. Which Water Aniimo is your favorite? Comment below!
description: Best endgame Water team in Aniimo (checked Nov 2026): Sherro (damage), Panpanta (break), Piopiota (support), Prismana Glacy (healer). Panpanta breaks, Glacy buffs, Sherro finishes near the puddles.
